ideas.name: ES Bid Density Reversal
ideas.claim: The author describes an ES reversal setup using rising bid density after a downward move.
ideas.quote: During medium to high volume on the ES, you can typically see directional movements tested with quick reversals (4 tick~ moves).

rules.entry: In the example, after a six-tick decline and rising bid density over the last three ticks, place a bid limit one tick lower.
rules.exit: In the example, exit after a four-tick bounce.
rules.filters: Medium to high volume; numerical thresholds not stated.

ideas.claimed_result: The author states that the algorithm was not profitable at the time of posting.

ideas.name: Value Area Absorption Rejection
ideas.claim: Trade ES reactions at the previous session's value-area boundaries using absorption and candle-close confirmation.
ideas.quote: For absorption entries, I want to see at least 100+ delta absorbed at a price level.
ideas.mechanism: Order-flow absorption at previous session value-area boundaries

rules.entry: Trade a reaction at the previous session's value-area high or low with at least 100 delta absorbed at a price level and a candle close at least 1–2 ticks away from the absorption.
rules.exit: A 1:1 risk-reward ratio is stated; target placement is not stated.
rules.filters: Trade from 9:30 to 10:45 AM ET. If the previous session was a holiday or abnormal, use the prior regular session.

ideas.claimed_result: The author reports 99 wins and 83 losses across approximately 182 manually backtested trades from January 2021 through July 2023, and says little expectancy remained after fees.
